$comment: Tolerances and thresholds for the DEXPI conformance suite. Every value is intentional — see the notes.

structural.$positionNote: A symbol centroid may differ by up to 2 mm OR 5% of the diagram's bbox diagonal (whichever is larger) before it counts as `position-off`. pyDEXPI and our projection both work in native DEXPI millimetres, so absolute mm is meaningful; the % term keeps large drawings fair.
structural.$sizeNote: Symbol width/height may differ by 15%. Stencil bounding boxes are authored independently of DEXPI Extent, so exact size parity is not expected — this only catches gross mismatches (e.g. default 40x40 fallback vs a real 160mm vessel).
structural.$rotationNote: Rotation is quantised to 90° steps in practice; 1° absorbs float noise.
structural.$passRule: PASS = no symbol-missing / symbol-extra / symbol-class-mismatch / position-off / rotation-mismatch / connection-missing / connection-extra. WARN = only size-off / label-mismatch / style-diff. FAIL = anything else.

visual.$visualNote: Visual diff is NON-BLOCKING — it never turns a structural PASS into a FAIL. hardFailRatio only flags rows as `visual-way-off` in the report for human triage. Rendering via headless Chromium (Playwright) for browser-faithful output.
visual.$monochromeNote: Our SVG carries the Osiris light theme; the pyDEXPI reference is neutral black-on-white. Both are flattened to monochrome before pixelmatch so colour choices don't dominate the diff.

corpus.classification: proteus-graphics only (has drawing primitives AND pyDEXPI renders it); semantic-only and unrenderable files are recorded but excluded from PASS/FAIL.
